mapper.sql: select p.page_id, p.page_code, p.route_path, p.template_code, p.draft_revision_id, p.published_revision_id, p.previous_published_revision_id, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, coalesce(d.title, r.title) as title from site_page p left join site_page_revision d on d.revision_id = p.draft_revision_id left join site_page_revision r on r.revision_id = p.published_revision_id

select revision_id, page_id, revision_no, revision_state, title, subtitle, body_html, seo_json, page_data_json, content_hash, published_at, published_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from site_page_revision
mapper.select:
p.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(d.title, r.title) like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and p.route_path like concat('%', #{routePath}, '%')
order by p.page_id
where p.page_id = #{pageId} and p.del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.update: update site_page set draft_revision_id = #{draftRevisionId}, published_revision_id = #{publishedRevisionId}, previous_published_revision_id = #{previousPublishedRevisionId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where page_id = #{pageId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into site_page (page_code, route_path, template_code, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{pageCode}, #{routePath}, #{templateCode}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_page set page_code = #{pageCode}, route_path = #{routePath}, template_code = #{templateCode}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where page_id = #{pageId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where page_id = #{pageId} and revision_state = 'DRAFT' order by revision_no desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(revision_no), 0) + 1 from site_page_revision where page_id = #{pageId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_page_revision (page_id, revision_no, revision_state, title, subtitle, body_html, seo_json, page_data_json, content_hash, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{pageId}, #{revisionNo}, #{revisionState}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{bodyHtml}, #{seoJson}, #{pageDataJson}, #{contentHash}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_page_revision set title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, body_html = #{bodyHtml}, seo_json = #{seoJson}, page_data_json = #{pageDataJson}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where revision_id = #{revisionId} and revision_state = 'DRAFT'

update site_page_revision set revision_state = #{revisionState}, published_at = case when #{revisionState} = 'PUBLISHED' then sysdate() else published_at end, published_by = case when #{revisionState} = 'PUBLISHED' then #{publishedBy} else published_by end where revision_id = #{revisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_publish_audit (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, action_type, from_revision_id, to_revision_id, operator, reason) values ('PAGE', #{aggregateId}, #{actionType}, #{fromRevisionId}, #{toRevisionId}, #{operator}, #{reason})
mapper.select: select * from ( select p.page_code, p.route_path, p.template_code, r.title, r.subtitle, r.body_html, r.seo_json, r.page_data_json, r.content_hash, r.published_at from site_page p inner join site_page_revision r on r.revision_id = p.published_revision_id where p.route_path = #{routePath} and p.del_flag = '0' and r.revision_state = 'PUBLISHED' union all select a.article_code as page_code, a.legacy_path as route_path, 'LEGACY_ARTICLE' as template_code, r.title, r.summary as subtitle, r.body_html, r.seo_json, null as page_data_json, r.content_hash, r.published_at from site_article a inner join site_article_revision r on r.revision_id = a.published_revision_id where a.legacy_path = #{routePath} and a.del_flag = '0' and r.revision_state = 'PUBLISHED' ) published_content limit 1
